title: Church of St. Janyl, Iyık Janyl | Cathedral of the Syro-Iradi Catholic Church
services_note: Times from 1 November (winter): Ramsha at 17:00. On feasts the Solemn Holy Qurbana replaces the 9:30 Qurbana; see the calendar. The cathedral closes to visitors during the Holy Qurbana; worshippers are always welcome.

items.what: Solemn Holy Qurbana. The Archbishop presides on the first Sunday of the month
Holy Qurbana for pilgrims and visitors
Holy Qurbana in the crypt, at the tomb of Mar Gewargis, for travellers and the sick
Baptisms and crownings, by arrangement with the cathedral office

calendar.name: Kudash Idta, the Dedication of the Church
calendar.note: The last season of the church year.

calendar.name: All Souls
calendar.note: Holy Qurbana for the faithful departed at 9:30, then prayers at the historic cemetery.

calendar.name: Commemoration of the victims of 1937
calendar.note: Memorial Holy Qurbana at 9:30. The names of clergy and laity taken from the diocese in 1937–38 are read in full.

calendar.name: Yuhanna of Merv
calendar.note: Commemoration of the monk who, by tradition, built the first house of prayer in the Talas valley.

calendar.name: Subara, the Annunciation, begins
calendar.note: The four weeks before the Nativity. A new church year.

calendar.name: Yalda, the Nativity of Our Lord
calendar.note: Night Qurbana on the 24th at 23:00; Solemn Holy Qurbana at 9:30 on the 25th.

calendar.name: Denha, the Epiphany
calendar.note: Blessing of the waters at the Naryn after the 9:30 Qurbana. Bring a vessel for water to take home.

calendar.name: Ninevi Savmasy, the Rogation of the Ninevites
calendar.note: Three days of fasting and prayer.

calendar.name: Uluu Savma, the Great Fast, begins
Achytky Beyshembi, Holy Thursday, and Süyünchü Künü, the Annunciation
calendar.note: This year the two fall on the same day. Renewal of the malka in the highland parishes.

calendar.name: Good Friday
calendar.note: Procession from the old town to Cathedral Hill.

calendar.name: Kyamta, the Resurrection
calendar.note: Night Qurbana from 23:00 on the 27th, broadcast by IradOne.

calendar.name: The Assumption
calendar.note: Memorial prayers for the Lost Tribes of 1916.

calendar.name: Feast of St. Janyl
calendar.note: Vigil procession from the old town on the evening of the 23rd; Holy Qurbana and the Blessing of the Herds on the 24th.

calendar.name: Salyba Künü, the Feast of the Cross
calendar.note: Anniversary of the union of 1931 and the reconsecration of 1992. The end of the pilgrimage season.
